name: Tri City Monsters: Raath
source:
Plagued with a dark burden, Raath is more monster than anything you've seen so far. In this full length, standalone story, uncover what makes him tick and make the heavy choice of diffusing or unleashing his violent grudge.

Tread carefully, however, as getting closer to him intensifies everything, even your own mortal peril. More blood for the blood god, afterall.

[From [url=https://www.tricitymonsters.com/game]official website[/url]]
translation:
背负着黑暗宿命的拉斯，比你迄今为止见过的任何存在都更像一头真正的怪物。在这部篇幅完整、剧情独立的篇章中，揭开驱使他行动的内心秘密，并做出沉重的抉择——是平息还是彻底释放他那狂暴的怨恨。

不过请务必步步小心，因为越是靠近他，一切就越发剑拔弩张，就连你自己的性命也会岌岌可危。毕竟，血祭血神嘛。

[摘自[url=https://www.tricitymonsters.com/game]官方网站[/url]]
